# Agent reliability

134 questions carry a firm `agent_reliability` label: 11 appear in a candidate sitting, 24 in a compiled report, 99 in a study bank. A question counted in two sources is counted in each.

What the candidate is asked to do: explain 75, design 27, diagnose 10, implement 6, evaluate 1.

These are counts of questions that were written down. They are not the probability that anyone asks them. Company names are tags copied from a bank unless the cell says *stated*, which means the candidate named the employer.
